description: Work with your Bird workspace: manage contacts, custom properties and audiences, send, schedule and follow email, look up SMS templates, senders and numbers, and manage webhooks.

bird_new_contact_trigger.description: Runs for each new contact in your Bird workspace, with their email, phone, name, custom properties and audiences. Contacts already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.audiences: The names of the audiences they are in.
output.contact_id: The contact's ID in Bird, for the other Bird steps.
output.email: Their email address, if they have one.
output.external_id: Your own ID for them, if set.
output.phone_number: Their phone number, if they have one.

bird_new_email_trigger.description: Runs for each new email sent from your Bird workspace, with its subject, sender, recipients and category. Emails already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.created_at: When the email was sent or scheduled.
output.message_id: The email's ID in Bird, for 'Get email' and 'List email events'.
output.status: Its delivery status when the trigger first saw it.
output.subject: The subject line.
